units: Midd. V, 4 לִשְׁכַּת העץ the compartment (in the Temple) for the storage of wood; ל׳ הגולה the compartment containing the pilgrims’ well; ל׳ הגזית, v. גָּזִית.—Esp. הל׳ the Temple treasury for congregational sacrifices.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 3:2">Shek. III, 2</cite> <he>בשלש … תורמין את הל׳</he> the funds in the treasury are arranged in three piles.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 3:2">Ib.</cite> <he>תרומת הל׳</he> the treasure of &c. Ib. IV, 1 <he>נוטלין שכרן מתרומת הל׳</he> receive their wages out of the Temple fund; a. fr.—Pl. <he>לְשָׁכוֹת</he>.
